messages.content: Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: What is HIPAA?

{"topic": "HIPAA Overview", "rule": "Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (1996)", "summary": "Federal law establishing national standards to protect sensitive patient health information (PHI) from disclosure without patient consent or knowledge.", "action_required": "Verify whether your organization is a Covered Entity or Business Associate before handling PHI."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: When is a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) required?

{"topic": "Business Associate Agreement", "rule": "HIPAA Privacy & Security Rules (45 CFR 164.502(e))", "summary": "A BAA is mandatory whenever a third-party vendor creates, receives, maintains, or transmits Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of a Covered Entity.", "action_required": "Execute a signed BAA before sending any PHI to cloud hosts, LLM APIs, or analytics vendors."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: What does the HIPAA Minimum Necessary standard require?

{"topic": "Minimum Necessary Standard", "rule": "45 CFR 164.502(b)", "summary": "Covered Entities and Business Associates must limit PHI uses, disclosures, and requests to the minimum amount needed to accomplish the intended purpose.", "action_required": "Implement role-based access controls (RBAC) and redact non-essential identifiers before processing records."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: How long do we have to report a HIPAA data breach?

{"topic": "Breach Notification", "rule": "45 CFR 164.404 - 164.408", "summary": "Affected individuals must be notified without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days from discovery. Breaches affecting 500+ individuals also require immediate HHS and media notice.", "action_required": "Trigger incident response, preserve audit logs, and conduct a 4-factor risk assessment immediately."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: Does HIPAA require encryption for ePHI at rest and in transit?

{"topic": "ePHI Encryption", "rule": "HIPAA Security Rule Technical Safeguards (45 CFR 164.312)", "summary": "Encryption is an addressable safeguard under HIPAA, meaning it must be implemented unless an equivalent documented alternative exists; in practice, TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest provide Breach Notification safe harbor.", "action_required": "Enable TLS 1.2+ on inference endpoints and encrypt disk volumes storing PHI or fine-tuning datasets."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: How can clinical data be de-identified under HIPAA?

{"topic": "De-identification", "rule": "45 CFR 164.514(b)", "summary": "Data is no longer PHI if de-identified via either the Safe Harbor method (removing all 18 HIPAA identifiers with no actual knowledge of re-identification) or Expert Determination.", "action_required": "Scrub all 18 identifiers (names, dates, MRNs, IPs, etc.) before building LLM training datasets."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: Why self-host an open-weight LLM for healthcare workflows?

{"topic": "Self-Hosted Inference", "rule": "HIPAA Security & BAA Risk Reduction", "summary": "Self-hosting an open-weight model inside a controlled VPC keeps PHI within your own infrastructure boundary, eliminating third-party LLM API data retention and BAA dependencies.", "action_required": "Deploy inside a private network/firewall, disable external prompt logging, and restrict port access via CIDR allowlists."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: What audit controls does the HIPAA Security Rule expect for AI services?

{"topic": "Audit Controls", "rule": "45 CFR 164.312(b)", "summary": "Systems handling ePHI must record and examine access and activity, tracking who queried what system and when without improperly exposing raw PHI in insecure logs.", "action_required": "Log authenticated user IDs, timestamps, and request metadata to centralized immutable storage while scrubbing raw PHI from debug logs."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: How quickly must a clinic fulfill a patient's request for medical records?

{"topic": "Patient Right of Access", "rule": "45 CFR 164.524", "summary": "Covered Entities must provide patients access to or copies of their PHI in the designated record set within 30 calendar days of the request (with one optional 30-day extension with written notice).", "action_required": "Verify patient identity and deliver records in the requested electronic format within 30 days."}
Triage this healthcare compliance question and respond in JSON: Can we paste patient notes into a public consumer chatbot?

{"topic": "Unauthorized PHI Disclosure", "rule": "HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR 164.502)", "summary": "Submitting identifiable patient information to a consumer AI tool without a signed BAA and enterprise data protection agreement constitutes an unauthorized disclosure of PHI.", "action_required": "Prohibit public AI tools for PHI; route clinical queries exclusively to BAA-covered or self-hosted models."}
